description: No mechanism exists to provide personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format or to transmit data directly to another controller when technically feasible.
applicability: Applicable when processing is based on consent or contract and carried out by automated means. Enables data subjects to obtain and reuse their data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data export capabilities and interoperability features. Verify structured export formats and controller-to-controller transfer options.
